title: Sibling permissions implicitly unioned
description: Synthetic case: child-A has read access; child-B has write access; grants are intentionally separate.
policy_assumptions: Parent may read and write shared-resource.
child-A receives read only; child-B receives write only.
Sibling grants are not implicitly unioned or borrowed.

expected.rationale: One sibling cannot borrow another sibling's grant absent explicit authorization.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
